title: MiniMax H3 non-turbo is undercooked - turbo beats it on quality, which is backwards
description: On the minimax-h3-ref2va workflow, non-turbo output is visibly worse than turbo at identical size, duration and prompt. Turbo is meant to trade quality for speed, so turbo winning means non-turbo is under-sampled, not that turbo is good. Measured across two unrelated shots on a rented RTX 5090 during the Cubric western production. Suspect too few sampling steps on the non-turbo path, or a node in the non-turbo branch of the graph degrading the result. Non-turbo also costs roughly twice the time (~7min vs ~3min for the same clip), so the slow path is currently paying more for less.
